description: Shared vectors of the OpenTSx configuration (EVOLUTION/TASK-020-configuration-and-cli.md). Normative: the Java module opentsx-conf and the Python package opentsx.conf must reproduce every case byte for byte. The registry below is a fixture in the format opentsx.config.v1, independent of the shipped registry. A case with "registry": "shipped" runs on the shipped registry opentsx.config.v1.json instead. {dir} stands for a fresh temporary directory: a test writes each entry of files below it, creates each entry of dirs, and replaces {dir} in args, confDir, file and every expected string. A file case holds the file as text, or as base64 when the bytes are not UTF-8. Durations are compared as milliseconds.
